description: The project owner's consumer-law questions, copied VERBATIM from chat on 2026-11-08, BEFORE consumer law was added to NyayaAI. Do not edit.
author: project owner
questions: I ordered an iPhone from an online shopping website for ₹65,000, but the package contained a cheap dummy phone. I've contacted customer support several times, but they keep rejecting my refund request. What are my consumer rights?

I purchased a weight-loss product after seeing an advertisement claiming that it would show results in 15 days. It didn't work at all, and now the company is refusing to refund me. Can I take action against the company for misleading advertising?

I bought a new washing machine for ₹35,000 from a shop in Guwahati. Within two weeks it stopped working. The seller keeps sending technicians but refuses to replace it or refund my money. What can I do legally?

I bought a second-hand car from a dealer in Delhi. He assured me that the car was in perfect condition, but within a week the engine developed a serious problem. The dealer says he is not responsible because I bought a used car. Do I have any legal protection?

I paid a private hospital in Kolkata for a medical package, but several tests included in the package were never conducted. The hospital is refusing to refund the amount for those tests. Can I file a consumer complaint?
